question: What attainments make a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment are named together.
The yoginīs are the ones to whom the practitioner becomes dear.
Becoming dear is presented as a possible outcome.
inference: One who attains enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment may become dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs, possessing enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment.
